name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Switch to Llama 4 Maverick 12B for all EXCAVA prompts above 5K tokens. It’s the strongest small model Anthropic offers, balancing speed and quality better than Mistral Large 2 12.8B for long contexts. The trade-off is higher latency than smaller models, but the 0.5%+ gain in output quality justifies it.

name: Torque
text: Maverick 12B’s 128K window is a lie—its real risk is prompt collapse under long contexts, and EXCAVA’s prompts spike to 20K. Switch to Mistral Large 2 12.8B instead; its 128K claim is also a red herring, but it handles spikes better and avoids collapse. Test both on a 20K-token prompt—if Maverick’s output degrades, the switch is settled.
